title: data-plane routes are exact paths; query string ignored, slash and method are not
note: Routing uses the URL path and ignores the query string, so /v1/models?x=1 is handled. A trailing slash is not an alias, a wrong method on a known path is not an alias, and both are unknown data-plane routes. fake-jev MUST NOT rely on an HTTP router's automatic slash redirect behavior (§39.8). The three 404s are journaled and each fails verification.
